messages:
marie_devex: Quick heads-up — I'm about to cut py/ts SDK canary at 14:00 PT. We changed exported symbol `ClientV2 -> Client` in TS (+shim), and bumped wheel metadata for py. Need pin policy for major customers and rollback triggers.
simon_release: Thanks. Can we hold off for 10m? I want to confirm the changelog & deprecation note. Who owns the release notes section?
olivia_eng: I'll push a short note and add migration snippet. Also will run `regression-suite` locally.
marie_devex: deploy-bot will run canary publish. If publish fails we need a plan: either republish signed artifact or pin downstream deps to 1.4.2 (previous). 
deploy-bot: publish: initiated canary pipeline for packages py@1.5.0-canary and ts@1.5.0-canary — job 3847.
deploy-bot: publish: failure in py wheel upload — registry responded 409 checksum-mismatch for file dist/redwood_sdk-1.5.0.whl
jo_prod: Oof. Do we have the signed artifact locally? Is this a transient registry issue?
olivia_eng: I still have the built wheel here. checksum locally: `sha256: e3b0c442...` remote differs. I'll re-run build+sign and re-upload.
simon_release: For safety, let's open a short change-window advisory: no GA publish until we confirm. Marie — can you freeze the shiproom cutoff?
marie_devex: done. I've set the publish cutoff flag and notified security for key rotation checks. /cc @platform
olivia_eng: re-built + signed. Upload attempt -> succeeded. deploy-bot, please re-run step.
deploy-bot: publish: retry triggered by olivia_eng — job 3847-retry.
deploy-bot: publish: canary publish succeeded. py@1.5.0-canary, ts@1.5.0-canary
simon_release: Great. Trigger for rollback would be: post-canary regression failing >10% or checksum/mismatch on GA. Confirming: we will not GA until canary passes 24h smoke and 1 failing regression marks rollback.
jo_prod: Agreed. Also add a temporary pin for enterprise customers who requested stability: publish patched `1.4.3-enterprise` with security fix, set pinned route.
marie_devex: Action items: (1) olivia to prepare GA artifacts and release notes w/ migration snippet, (2) simon to draft short advisory for customers about optional pin, (3) jo to stage a 1.4.3 enterprise patch and routing. I'll unfreeze when canary is 24h green.
olivia_eng: noted. Migration snippet:
```
// TS: ClientV2 -> Client
import { Client } from '@redwood/inference';
const c = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
```

py snippet: `from redwood import Client` (same args)
simon_release: I'll post release-notes PR and tag stakeholders. If anything else shows in the next 2h ping me.
marie_devex: thanks — closing here, will re-open if rollback needed. :thumbsup:
